echoParts: For as often as you eat this bread
verseText: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
meaning: This verse explains why we celebrate the Lord's Supper. We eat bread and drink the cup to proclaim the good news of Jesus's death for our sins.
